General recommendation.text: It is recommended to base the revascularization strategy (IRA PCI, multivessel PCI/CABG) on the patient's clinical status and comorbidities, as well as their disease complexity, according to the principles of management of myocardial revascularization.

IRA-only PCI during the index procedure.text: IRA-only PCI during the index procedure is recommended.

Staged PCI of non-IRA.text: Staged PCI of non-IRA should be considered.
Staged PCI of non-IRA.note: Based on ischaemia, symptoms, patient comorbidities, and clinical condition.

Complete revascularization timing.text: Complete revascularization is recommended either during the index PCI procedure or within 45 days.

PCI of non-IRA based on angiographic sev.text: It is recommended that PCI of the non-IRA is based on angiographic severity.

Invasive epicardial functional assessmen.text: Invasive epicardial functional assessment of non-culprit segments of the IRA is not recommended during the index procedure.

Complete revascularization consideration.text: In patients presenting with NSTE-ACS and MVD, complete revascularization should be considered, preferably during the index procedure.

Functional invasive evaluation of non-IR.text: Functional invasive evaluation of non-IRA severity during the index procedure may be considered.

Footnotes.c: Based on ischaemia, symptoms, patient comorbidities, and clinical condition
